description: Ministry of Higher Education & Cultural Affairs - Notify the Order to recognize the Saegis Campus (Private) Limited as a Degree Awarding Institute under the Universities Act, No. 16 of 1978
categorisation: This gazette notification involves the recognition of a private educational institution (Saegis Campus) as a degree-awarding institute under the Universities Act. While it is issued by a government minister, the content primarily deals with educational matters and accreditation of a private institution rather than government structure, personnel, or any of the specialized categories (land, legal, commercial, elections, public service, or judicial). The focus is on academic standards and degree programs, which falls under the Miscellaneous category for educational matters.
